definitions.text_mt: Il-ġenitur ta' sess femminil f'familja.

usage_examples.mt: L-omm kienet tipproteġi lill-uliedha b'imħabba kbira.
usage_examples.en: The mother protected her children with great love.

definitions.text_mt: Il-ġenitur ta' sess maskil fil-familja.

usage_examples.mt: Missier it-tifel kien jaħdem bħala bidwi fil-kampanja.
usage_examples.en: The child's father was working as a farmer in the countryside.

definitions.text_mt: Ħidma u impenn fejn jaħdem bniedem kuljum.

usage_examples.en: He went to work at eight o'clock in the morning.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna jew membru tar-razza umana.

usage_examples.mt: Kull bniedem għandu dritt għall-paċi u d-dinjità.
usage_examples.en: Every human has a right to peace and dignity.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna żgħira fl-età tas-sess maskili.

usage_examples.en: The boy went to play with the ball in the square.

definitions.text_mt: Il-metodu u l-istil li bih tiċċaqlaq jew taġixxi.

usage_examples.mt: Kiteb id-dokument b'mod professjonali u ċar.
usage_examples.en: He wrote the document in a professional clear manner.

definitions.text_mt: Tifsira u deskrizzjoni ta' 'għandha': third-person feminine singular pronominal form of għand: at her / it, to her / it she / it has.

usage_examples.mt: Għandha kien f'postu fil-bini u fl-użu ta' kuljum.
usage_examples.en: The għandha was in its proper place in daily use.

definitions.text_mt: Il-bnedmin kollha miġbura fil-komunità u l-pajjiż.

usage_examples.mt: In-nies kollha tar-raħal inġabru fil-pjazza prinċipali.
usage_examples.en: All the village people gathered in the main square.

definitions.text_mt: Grupp ta' nies imqabbdin b'rabta ta' demm, żwieġ jew adozzjoni użati li jgħixu flimkien.

usage_examples.mt: Il-familja kollha inġabret madwar il-mejda għall-ikla tal-Ħadd.
usage_examples.en: The whole family gathered around the table for Sunday lunch.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' ċomb fl-użu u t-tifsira uffiċjali.
Il-forma jew l-istat ta' persuna jew oġġett mfassal.

usage_examples.mt: Figura storika li ddominat it-tieni nofs tas-seklu.
usage_examples.en: A historical figure who dominated the second half of the century.

definitions.text_mt: Bniedem u individwu fiżiku fis-soċjetà.

usage_examples.mt: Kull persuna għandha d-drittijiet fundamentali tagħha.
usage_examples.en: Every person has their fundamental rights.

definitions.text_mt: Żerriegħa użata biex tikber pjanta jew fil-ġisem.

usage_examples.en: He planted the seed in fresh soil.

definitions.text_mt: Bniedem adult ta' sess femminili.
Il-sieħba femminili marbuta b'żwieġ uffiċjali.

usage_examples.mt: Il-mara tiegħu kienet taħdem bħala professur fl-università.
usage_examples.en: His wife was working as a professor at the university.

definitions.text_mt: Tifsira u deskrizzjoni ta' 'ġlieda': fight, quarrel, argument.

usage_examples.mt: Ġlieda kien f'postu fil-bini u fl-użu ta' kuljum.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna professjonali fil-mediċina li tikkura l-morda.

usage_examples.mt: Is-sajjied mar għand it-tabib biex jiċċekkja saħħtu.
usage_examples.en: The fisherman went to the doctor to check his health.

definitions.text_mt: Il-uffiċjal jew il-mexxej ewlieni fuq vapur, ajruplan jew tim sportiv.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kaptan tal-vapur ta l-ordnijiet biex itellgħu l-ankra.
usage_examples.en: The ship's captain gave orders to raise the anchor.
